import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = (1 << 20);
    static final int mod = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final double eps = 1e-9;
    static final double pi = Math.acos(-1.0);

    static long bp(long x, long y) {
        long z = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1)
                z = (z * x) % mod;
            x = (x * x) % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return z;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());

        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        double[][] p = new double[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = Double.parseDouble(br.readLine()) * bp(100, mod - 2) % mod;
            }
        for (int i = n; i < 6; i++)
            for (int j = n; j < 6; j++)
                p[i][j] = 1;

        List<int[]> E = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});

        long[] F = new long[N];
        int nump = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; j++)
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; k++) {
                    List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                    v.add(i);
                    v.add(j);
                    v.add(k);
                    do {
                        int mask1 = 0;
                        for (int ii : v) {
                            mask1 |= (1 << (ii * 3));
                        }
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1)
                                F[mask | (1 << nump)] |= (1 << i);
                        }
                    } while (nextPermutation(v));
                    nump++;
                }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
            long v = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                if ((mask >> i & 1) == 1)
                    v = (v * p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]]) % mod;
                else
                    v = (v * (1 - p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]] + mod)) % mod;
            }
            F[mask] += v;
            if (F[mask] >= mod)
                F[mask] -= mod;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); mask++)
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 1)
                    F[mask] = (F[mask] + F[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % mod;

        long[] m = new long[(1 << 18)];
        Arrays.fill(m, 0);
        nump = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
            for (int j = i + 1; j < 6; j++)
                for (int k = j + 1; k < 6; k++) {
                    List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < 6; ii++)
                        if (ii != i && ii != j && ii != k)
                            v.add(ii);
                    do {
                        int mask1 = 0;
                        for (int ii : v) {
                            mask1 |= (1 << (ii * 3));
                        }
                        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
                            if ((mask & mask1) == mask1)
                                m[mask] |= (1 << nump);
                        }
                    } while (nextPermutation(v));
                    nump++;
                }

        E.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
            for (int j = 3; j < 6; j++)
                E.add(new int[]{i, j});

        long ans = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); mask++) {
            long v = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                if ((mask >> i & 1) == 1)
                    v = (v * p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]]) % mod;
                else
                    v = (v * (1 - p[E.get(i)[0]][E.get(i)[1]] + mod)) % mod;
            }
            ans = (ans + v * ((1 - F[((1 << 20) - 1) ^ m[mask]] + mod) % mod) % mod) % mod;
        }

        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> v) {
        int i = v.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v.get(i) >= v.get(i + 1))
            i--;
        if (i == -1)
            return false;
        int j = v.size() - 1;
        while (v.get(j) <= v.get(i))
            j--;
        Collections.swap(v, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(v.subList(i + 1, v.size()));
        return true;
    }
